reviews.title: Great card for scientific computing
reviews.comment: A2000 is a great card with low power usage but can tun up to 22 qubit quantum simulation with NVIDIA cuQuantum package. This card is great for small machines.
reviews.author: Samuel Chen

reviews.title: Good product and service
reviews.comment: I ordered this card as a second, duplicate GPU for my workstation.  The card was delivered quickly, and was packaged well.  Installation was easy, and the card performs flawlessly.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
